method.title: From brief to payout, <muted>six steps overseen by our team</muted>
method.lead: The INFLUX team steps in at key stages. Everything happens on the platform and stays on record, protecting brands and creators alike.

brief.title: You publish your brief
brief.body: Product, goals, formats, budget (INFLUX commission included), timing and target audience: you describe your campaign. Our team reviews and approves it before it goes live.

teamSelection.title: We hand-pick creators
teamSelection.body: Someone from the INFLUX team picks verified creators for your brief and explains each suggestion. You accept or decline, with usernames hidden until signing.

messaging.title: You talk it through in INFLUX
messaging.body: Deliverables, dates, tone: you settle the details with the creator in a messaging space dedicated to each introduction, where your conversations are kept.

contract.title: You sign the contract in INFLUX
contract.body: The contract states, in a single currency, its amount, the included INFLUX commission and its two shares, and the creator’s net amount. It’s only available when both parties are in countries open to contracts.

securePayment.title: The brand pays through INFLUX
securePayment.body: Payment goes through a licensed payment provider. The amount paid is the contract amount, INFLUX commission included; the creator’s net amount is paid out after the publication is approved.

publicationPayout.title: Approval, then payout
publicationPayout.body: The creator uploads proof of publication, the brand approves it, then the creator’s net amount is paid out. On a first contract, the creator verifies their identity and bank details with the provider.

creatorNetwork.title: Our team presents your profile <muted>to brands in your space</muted>
creatorNetwork.lead: Complete your profile, get your stats verified and browse open campaigns. Your username stays hidden until the contract is signed.

ugc.title: Content for your own channels
ugc.body: Photos and videos shot by creators, to post on your pages and ads. How long and where you may use them is set out in the contract.

acquisition.title: Promote an offer
acquisition.body: A discount code or limited-time offer shared by creators; you track sales with your own tools.
acquisition.formats: promo code in stories, short video, post

productLaunch.title: Release a new product
productLaunch.body: Introduce your product from day one to an audience already drawn to your category.

awareness.title: Become part of a community
awareness.body: Build a lasting presence with creators whose editorial style matches your brand.

faq.title: What to know <muted>before you sign up</muted>
faq.lead: Money, countries, profiles, messaging: the essentials, for brands and creators alike.

signupCost.question: Does it cost anything to sign up for INFLUX?
signupCost.answer: No. Signing up is free for brands and creators alike, with no subscription. INFLUX only earns money through a commission on contracts signed on the platform: as long as no contract is signed, you pay nothing to INFLUX.

commission.question: How much does INFLUX cost, and what does the creator get?
commission.answer: The INFLUX commission is 35% of the contract amount: a 20% advertiser share and a 15% creator share, both included in that amount, which is the brand’s total cost. Example in euros: on a €2,000.00 contract, the INFLUX commission is €700.00 (of which €400.00 advertiser share and €300.00 creator share) and the net paid to the creator is €1,300.00. Details in the Pricing section.

payment.question: How does payment work, and when is the creator paid?
payment.answer: The brand pays the contract amount on INFLUX, through a licensed payment provider. The creator’s net amount, meaning the contract amount minus the INFLUX commission, is paid out to the creator through that provider once the brand approves the publication. On their first contract, creators verify their identity and add their bank details with the provider.

currency.question: Which currency and language are contracts in?
currency.answer: Each contract uses a single currency, chosen from the list offered by INFLUX: the contract amount, the INFLUX commission and the creator’s net amount are all stated in that currency. The platform and contracts are available in French and English.

openCountries.question: Can I sign a contract from my country?
openCountries.answer: Anyone can sign up, wherever they are. Contracts, however, open country by country, after legal, tax and payment checks: a contract is only possible if the brand and the creator are each located in an open country. If yours isn’t open yet, your account stays active and we’ll let you know as soon as it opens.

hiddenHandles.question: Why are creators’ usernames hidden?
hiddenHandles.answer: So that choices rest on verified information and the collaboration is concluded in INFLUX, where the contract and payment protect both parties. Before signing, the brand sees topics, audience, verified stats, portfolio and the “verified” badge. Usernames and social links are shared with the brand once the contract is signed.

messaging.question: Why do conversations go through INFLUX messaging?
messaging.answer: Because it protects you. Messages are kept and linked to the introduction, so if there’s a disagreement about what was agreed, everyone can refer back to them. The contract and secure payment only exist in INFLUX, which is also how our team can support you all the way to the creator’s payout.

eligibility.question: Who can join as a creator, and how are profiles verified?
eligibility.answer: Any creator of legal age under the law where they live, whether an individual or a professional. Minors are not accepted. Our team checks the stats provided and the ownership of each account, for example with a code added to the bio. Checked profiles get the “verified” badge. On their first contract, creators also verify their identity with the payment provider.
